eligible.content: That cloth strip idea is clever—I tried something similar once, but the fabric disintegrated after a couple of days. For your weekend trip, are you using cotton or something more durable? I’m curious if it actually delivers enough water or if the pot still ends up too dry by Sunday.

"It's actually a high-durability, synthetic blend—it's much more resilient. It's definitely designed to hold up for the whole trip; hopefully, it keeps the soil moist enough so the plants don't dry out by Sunday!"
